sintesis.en: Demonstrators protesting against Spain's housing crisis reacted with fury on Friday after the country's parliament rejected two bills put forward by the government that centre-left Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez hoped would address their concerns. titulo.es: Ejecución fallida de Christa Pike en Tennessee reaviva debate sobre la pena de muerte en EE.UU.
titulo.en: Botched execution of Christa Pike in Tennessee reignites US death penalty debate

sintesis.es: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte en Tennessee, sobrevivió a dos dosis de pentobarbital durante su ejecución el 30 de septiembre de 2026 y permanece inconsciente y conectada a un respirador en un hospital de Nashville. Sus abogados denunciaron un proceso 'bárbaro, cruel y tortuoso', con al menos siete intentos fallidos de canalizar una vía intravenosa. El incidente, que hubiera convertido a Pike en la primera mujer ejecutada en Tennessee en 200 años, reavivó el debate público sobre la pena capital en Estados Unidos y generó comentarios del presidente Trump.
sintesis.en: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, survived two doses of pentobarbital during her execution attempt on September 30, 2026, and remains unconscious on a ventilator in a Nashville hospital. Her lawyers described the process as 'barbaric, cruel and torturous,' noting at least seven failed attempts to establish an IV line. The incident, which would have made Pike the first woman executed in Tennessee in 200 years, has reignited public debate over capital punishment in the US and drew comments from President Trump.
